about: Keys and hand codes for survey-check-11.md, the independent check of replay-small-work.md (LIN-3189). Blind verdicts are not stored here: scripts/survey-check-11.mjs reads them from the readers' own transcripts and maps them through these keys.

rejudge.about: A fresh frontier-tier reader per ticket, given LIN-3189's own blind prompt with the two diffs re-assigned to A and B by a seeded coin (Python random.Random(3191)), launched in a seeded random order, against a parent tree extracted with git archive. One sentence was added to every prompt: never run an interactive command, and stop a test run that does not finish within two minutes. Two LIN-2414 readers stalled while copying the parent tree and applying the diffs (16 and 8 minutes, no process running) and were stopped; a third was given one more sentence, to judge by reading only, and finished.

basis.about: What each re-judged preference rests on, coded by this check's author after reading the reader's reasons and re-running tests. production = the two production changes behave differently in use; tests = production identical or equivalent, the preference is test strength (mutation or regression coverage); none = equivalent.

hindsightFree.about: The same protocol as LIN-3189 (its PROMPTS imported unchanged from scripts/survey-replay-prepare.mjs; mid-tier implementer, reviewer and close-out; one review pass; detached local worktrees at the original's parent), with one change: the ticket text is the earliest recoverable description from before implementation began. Blind reads are frontier tier against the FINAL description, the standard LIN-3189's blind reads used, with A and B set by a seeded coin (random.Random('3191-hfree-<id>')). Both clones' push URLs were set to a non-existent path for the whole run.
